description: This file defines a class RegistrationEventPersistSubscriber that subscribes to EmployeeSavedEvent events within the OrangeHRM system. Upon such events, it triggers registration event processing related to active and inactive employee count updates.

classes.name: RegistrationEventPersistSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to EmployeeSavedEvent and processes registration events for active and inactive employee counts.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Overrides parent method to subscribe to EmployeeSavedEvent with the handler 'onEmployeeSaved'.

methods.name: onEmployeeSaved
methods.description: Event handler that creates registration event processors for active and inactive employees and triggers their saveRegistrationEvent method.
